title: Changing Careers in a Fast World
text:
Many young people today expect to change careers several times during their lives. In the past, workers often stayed with one company until they retired. Now technology changes quickly, and new jobs appear while old ones disappear. As a result, employers value people who keep learning new skills.

Experts believe that the most useful skills in the future will be creativity, communication, and problem solving. Some schools are therefore teaching students how to work in teams and how to adapt to unexpected situations. Many adults also take online courses in the evenings to prepare for a different job. Although this path can be stressful, it gives workers more control over their future.

questions.text: According to the passage, what did workers often do in the past?
options: They stayed with one company until they retired.
They worked for several companies at once.

questions.text: What are some schools doing to prepare their students?
options: Teaching them how to work in teams and adapt to unexpected situations.
Reducing the number of courses they offer.
Asking students to choose one career at the age of ten.

questions.text: Why do employers value people who keep learning new skills?
options: Because technology changes quickly and jobs change with it.
Because learning is only useful for students.
Because workers should stay in one company.

questions.text: What can be inferred about adults who take online courses in the evenings?
options: They are not interested in their current work.
They want to be ready for possible changes in their careers.
They have no time to rest at all.
They are doing it only for fun.

vocabulary.definition: jobs or professions followed over a long period of time
people or companies that pay workers
to change in order to suit a new situation

paragraph_translations: Muitos jovens hoje esperam mudar de carreira várias vezes ao longo da vida. No passado, os trabalhadores costumavam permanecer em uma única empresa até se aposentarem. Hoje, a tecnologia muda rapidamente, e novos empregos surgem enquanto outros desaparecem. Por isso, os empregadores valorizam pessoas que continuam aprendendo novas habilidades.

Especialistas acreditam que as habilidades mais úteis no futuro serão criatividade, comunicação e resolução de problemas. Algumas escolas, portanto, estão ensinando os alunos a trabalhar em equipe e a se adaptar a situações inesperadas. Muitos adultos também fazem cursos on-line à noite para se preparar para um trabalho diferente. Embora esse caminho possa ser estressante, ele dá aos trabalhadores mais controle sobre o próprio futuro.
